ops.title: expose an env override for home resolution (test-sandbox seam, mirrors daemonkit realhome.EnvOverride)
ops.description: FuseKit resolves the passwd home itself and honors neither HOME nor DAEMONKIT_HOME. Consequence measured 2026-07-27 (cc-pool wave-2 lane): the two zero-seam cc-pool tests cannot be sandboxed without breaking TestDefaultCandidatePlanAcceptsAbsentFixedTarget ("runtime directory ... is not below user home"), so real ~/.cc-pool pollution (cc-pool bug 6ef1e56) stays open until fusekit grows the seam daemonkit already has.

ops.text: a documented env var (or typed test hook) lets tests relocate fusekit's passwd-derived home
cc-pool bug 6ef1e56 closable: TestDefaultCandidatePlanAcceptsAbsentFixedTarget passes under a fully sandboxed HOME
